def transform(g):
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    base_of=lambda row: Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    lines=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if base_of(r)!=bg]
    pat=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if base_of(r)==bg]
    seps=sorted({j for i in pat for j,x in enumerate(g[i]) if x!=bg})
    gaps=[(seps[k],seps[k+1]) for k in range(len(seps)-1)]
    def segs(row):
        base=base_of(row)
        res={}; used=set()
        for gi,(a,b) in enumerate(gaps):
            if row[a]==row[b] and row[a]!=base and a not in used and b not in used:
                res[gi]=row[a]; used.add(a); used.add(b)
        return res
    L=[segs(g[i]) for i in lines]
    out=[[bg]*len(gaps) for _ in range(len(lines)-1)]
    for r in range(1,len(lines)):
        prevc={L[r-1][k] for k in L[r-1]}
        for gi,c in L[r].items():
